### The Black and Pale Horses
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-black-and-pale-horses
Passage: Revelation 6:5-8
Points:
- The Lamb of God alone has authority to open the heavenly seals and enact God's purposes across the era between Christ's first and second coming.
- The fourth seal releases a pale horse whose rider brings deadly conflict, famine, plague, and devastation.
- God's judgment is tempered with mercy by restricting the rider's authority to one-fourth of the earth so that humanity is preserved.
- Calamities and diseases will occur throughout history, but Christ sets sovereign boundaries beyond which destruction cannot pass.
- Believers need not fear that wars or pandemics mean God has lost control or that His church will fail to survive.
